name: Sisters
source:
A nukige story about the humiliating days of twin sisters in the hands of their hentai uncle, as their parents are missing.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE064166.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一部拔作，讲述父母失踪后，一对双胞胎姐妹落入好色叔叔手中，日日遭受凌辱的故事。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE064166.html]DLsite[/url]]
